title: Simulator
lede: A dry run of the rule engine on a basket, the way SIS.Api would answer the till at subtotal. Nothing is held, closed or counted.

sale.title: The sale
sale.memberHint: Optional. Leave it blank for a walk-in. A member HQ knows is read from HQ: tier and points.
sale.firstPurchase: It is the member's first purchase
sale.couponsHint: Optional. Separate codes with a space or a comma. A coupon is checked against today, not the date below.
sale.draftHint: This campaign runs as its saved draft; the others run live.
sale.noDraft: This campaign has no saved draft: the run uses the live version.
sale.nothingLive: Nothing is published yet, so there is no live campaign to run. Run a campaign’s saved draft instead.
sale.noDrafts: There is no draft to run.

basket.title: Basket
basket.empty: The basket is empty. Find an item by its SKU or its name, or upload a CSV.
basket.full: A basket takes at most {{max}} lines.
basket.priceHint: HQ prices nothing in a dry run: give each line its unit price before promotions.

file.title_one: The basket is a file of {{n}} line, sent to HQ as written.
file.title_other: The basket is a file of {{n}} lines, sent to HQ as written.
file.more_one: …and {{n}} more line, sent with the rest.
file.more_other: …and {{n}} more lines, sent with the rest.

csv.title: Basket from a CSV
csv.format: Comma-separated. A header line names the columns: article (or material, sku), quantity (or qty) and net (the line's total before promotions) are required; line, unit, gross, vatRate, category and fee are optional. Then one line per cart line, with figures written 12.50. Every line is checked before the file is used.
csv.fixFirst: Fix or remove the lines marked before the file can be the basket.
csv.header: The header line does not name article, quantity and net.
csv.empty: A file is a header line and at least one cart line.

status.badQuantity: The quantity is not a number
status.quantityNotPositive: The quantity is not more than 0
status.badNet: The net is not a number
status.badGross: The gross is not a number
status.badVatRate: The VAT rate is not a number
status.badLine: The line number is not a whole number from 1
status.badFee: Fee is not true or false

run.needs: A run needs a basket with a unit price on every line, a store, a country, a channel, a date and a time.
run.needsLiveOrDraft: Nothing is published yet: pick a draft to run.
run.needsDraft: The campaign could not be read, so its draft cannot run. Run it live instead, or open the simulator again.
run.denied: You do not have the rule-author permission (RuleAuthoring) that a dry run needs.
run.openCampaign: Open the campaign to fix it
run.stale: The sale has changed since this run. Run it again to see the new result.

result.none: Fill in the sale and the basket, then Run.
result.bonusBuy: This store runs the bonus-buy engine today: at its till these rule campaigns do not apply until the store is flipped under Store engine switch.
result.basedNothing: Nothing is published yet. Run at {{at}}.
